title: SSO login fails with invalid SAML response
symptoms: users cannot log in with SSO
redirect loop after identity provider login
steps: Confirm the identity provider's signing certificate has not rotated or expired
Re-upload the current IdP metadata XML in Settings > Security > SSO
Check that the user's email in the IdP matches their account email exactly
Clear the SSO session cache with 'Sign out everywhere' and retry the login

title: Password reset email never arrives or link expired
steps: Check whether the account is locked and unlock it from the admin console
Ask the user to request a new reset link; links expire after 30 minutes
Verify the reset email was not quarantined by the customer's mail filter
If still blocked, issue a one-time login link from the admin console

title: Card payment declined at checkout
steps: Look up the decline code in the payments dashboard for the failed charge
If the code is 'authentication_required', ask the customer to complete 3-D Secure
Ask the customer to confirm the billing address matches the card issuer's records
Retry the charge or switch the subscription to invoice billing

title: Invoice amount does not match plan price
steps: Open the invoice and compare line items with the subscription change history
Explain proration if seats or plan changed mid-cycle
If a duplicate charge is confirmed, issue a refund for the duplicate payment
Add a credit note and send the corrected invoice to the billing contact

title: API requests timing out or slow dashboards
steps: Check the status page and the regional latency dashboards for an ongoing incident
Identify the slow endpoints from the customer's request ids in the gateway logs
Ask the customer to page large queries and add date filters to dashboard widgets
If one tenant is saturating capacity, raise their rate limit or move them to a dedicated pool

title: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests from the API
symptoms: integration stops syncing during bulk jobs
steps: Confirm the customer's current rate-limit tier and usage in the API console
Advise exponential backoff honoring the Retry-After header
Recommend the bulk endpoints for batch jobs instead of per-record calls
Offer a temporary rate-limit increase for one-off migrations

title: Data not syncing between CRM integration and workspace
symptoms: changes in the CRM not reflected
steps: Check the integration's last successful sync time and error log
Re-authorize the CRM connection; expired OAuth tokens stop syncing silently
Trigger a manual full resync for the affected object type
Verify field mappings did not change after a CRM schema update

title: Mobile app crashes on launch
symptoms: app freezes on the splash screen
steps: Confirm the app version and OS version; versions older than the minimum are unsupported
Ask the user to update to the latest app release
Clear the app cache (Android) or offload and reinstall the app (iOS)
Collect the crash report id from Settings > Diagnostics for engineering

title: Email notifications not being delivered
steps: Check the notification preferences for the affected users
Look up the recipient in the email provider's suppression list and remove bounces
Ask the customer to allowlist our sending domain and check SPF/DKIM alignment
Send a test notification and confirm delivery in the message log
